general.description:
The "Land of the Watchdogs" is the Gham Garri's main base, it controls the Gham Dromae system and a few adjacent systems.
From this base, the "Watchdogs of Honor" launch regular attacks on the Free Adrimai exfiltration lanes, mainly those leading to Child of the Eclipse.
general.bar: You stand among fierce-looking Rithai, each of which would easily kill any being who would come in the path of the Gham Garri.
